prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred channels. I can narrow it down for you if you tell me a bit more, but here’s a quick guide to help you find the best fit in San Francisco and what to ask for when you evaluate agencies.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, leads, sales, app installs, SEO, etc.)
- What channels matter most? (PPC/Google, SEO, social ads, content, email, CRO, creative)
- Company stage/size and monthly marketing budget?
- Industry (SaaS, ecommerce, fintech, consumer, B2B, healthcare, etc.)
- Do you need global/enterprise-level capabilities or a nimble growth partner?

Where to find top SF agencies
- Clutch.co and The Manifest — filter by location, budget, vertical and read verified client reviews
- Google Partners directory for PPC specialists
- Meta/Facebook Marketing Partners for social advertisers
- G2 and LinkedIn for ratings and referrals
- Local awards lists (Ad Age, AdWeek, The Drum) for creative/brand shops

How to evaluate and vet agencies
- Ask for industry-relevant case studies with measurable KPIs (CAC, ROAS, MQLs, revenue lift)
- Request references and speak with a past client in a similar situation
- Check transparency on reporting and access to analytics/accounts
- Confirm team structure and who will be your day-to-day contact
- Clarify deliverables, timelines, and how performance is measured
- Get a clear scope and pricing model (monthly retainer vs. project vs. percentage of ad spend)

Typical matches by need (examples of what to look for)
- B2B SaaS growth — agencies with proven demand-gen, ABM and content/SEO for lead pipelines
- E‑commerce — specialists in Shopify/Magento, CRO, creative for ad platforms and logistics-aware ad strategies
- Brand/creative & product design — shops with strong UX, content and campaign creative portfolios
- Performance marketing — teams focused on paid search, paid social and measurable ROAS

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 4–6 San Francisco agencies tailored to your industry and budget, or
- Draft an RFP template you can use to solicit proposals

Tell me your goals, budget range and industry and I’ll shortlist the best local matches.
